author: Microsoft
name: macOS File System Extension
description: A project for creating an FSKit file system extension for a .NET macOS application

postActions.description: Add project reference in main app's project file

manualInstructions.text:
The final step is to add a reference to this newly created project in the main app's project file, like this:

	<ItemGroup>
		<ProjectReference Include="macOSFSKitExtension1.csproj">
			<IsAppExtension>true</IsAppExtension>
		</ProjectReference>
	</ItemGroup>

bundleId.description: The bundle identifier (CFBundleIdentifier from the Info.plist, or ApplicationId from the project file) for the parent macOS project

minOSVersion.description: Overrides SupportedOSPlatformVersion in the project file

fileSystemClassName.description: The name of the class that implements the file system

Framework.description: The target framework for the project.
